passages.text: The descendants of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
passages.sermon: Judah was a son of Jacob.\r\nJudah had descendants.\r\nHis descendants were Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֖י יְהוּדָ֑ה פֶּ֧רֶץ חֶצְר֛וֹן וְכַרְמִ֖י וְח֥וּר וְשׁוֹבָֽל׃

passages.text: Reaiah son of Shobal was the father of Jahath, and Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.
passages.sermon:
Reaiah was the son of Shobal.
Reaiah became the father of Jahath.
Jahath became the father of Ahumai.
Jahath also became the father of Lahad.
Ahumai and Lahad were brothers.
These men formed the clans of the Zorathites.
passages.original: וּרְאָיָ֤ה בֶן־ שׁוֹבָל֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ יַ֔חַת וְיַ֣חַת הֹלִ֔יד אֶת־ אֲחוּמַ֖י וְאֶת־ לָ֑הַד אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת הַצָּֽרְעָתִֽי׃ס

passages.text: These were the sons of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. And their sister was named Hazzelelponi.
passages.sermon:
Etam had sons.
Their names were Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash.
Etam also had a daughter.
Her name was Hazzelelponi.
passages.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ אֲבִ֣י עֵיטָ֔ם יִזְרְעֶ֥אל וְיִשְׁמָ֖א וְיִדְבָּ֑שׁ וְשֵׁ֥ם אֲחוֹתָ֖ם הַצְלֶלְפּֽוֹנִי׃

passages.text: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer was the father of Hushah. These were the descendants of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and the father of Bethlehem.
passages.sermon:
Hur was the firstborn son of Ephrathah.
Hur was the father of Bethlehem.
Penuel was a descendant of Hur.
Penuel was the father of Gedor.
Ezer was a descendant of Hur.
Ezer was the father of Hushah.
passages.original: וּפְנוּאֵל֙ אֲבִ֣י גְדֹ֔ר וְעֵ֖זֶר אֲבִ֣י חוּשָׁ֑ה אֵ֤לֶּה בְנֵי־ חוּר֙ בְּכ֣וֹר אֶפְרָ֔תָה אֲבִ֖י בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃

passages.text: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
passages.sermon:
Ashhur was the father of Tekoa.
Ashhur had two wives.
The name of one wife was Helah.
The name of the other wife was Naarah.
passages.original: וּלְאַשְׁחוּר֙ אֲבִ֣י תְק֔וֹעַ הָי֖וּ שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשִׁ֑ים חֶלְאָ֖ה וְנַעֲרָֽה׃

passages.text: Naarah bore to him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the descendants of Naarah.
passages.sermon:
Naarah was a wife of Ashhur, the father of Tekoa.
Naarah gave birth to Ahuzzam.
Naarah gave birth to Hepher.
Naarah gave birth to Temeni.
Naarah gave birth to Haahashtari.
Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari were the sons of Naarah.
These men were the descendants of Naarah.
passages.original: וַתֵּ֨לֶד ל֤וֹ נַעֲרָה֙ אֶת־ אֲחֻזָּ֣ם וְאֶת־ חֵ֔פֶר וְאֶת־ תֵּימְנִ֖י וְאֶת־ הָאֲחַשְׁתָּרִ֑י אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י נַעֲרָֽה׃

passages.text: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan, and Koz, who was the father of Anub and Zobebah and of the clans of Aharhel son of Harum.
passages.sermon:
Helah was one of the wives of Ashhur, the father of Tekoa.
Helah had several sons.
Her sons were Zereth, Zohar, Ethnan, and Koz.
Koz became the father of Anub.
Koz also became the father of Zobebah.
Koz was the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel.
Aharhel was the son of Harum.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י חֶלְאָ֑ה צֶ֥רֶת יִצְחָר וְאֶתְנָֽן׃ וְק֣וֹץ הוֹלִ֔יד אֶת־ עָנ֖וּב וְאֶת־ הַצֹּבֵבָ֑ה וּמִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת אֲחַרְחֵ֖ל בֶּן־ הָרֽוּם׃

passages.text: Now Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother had named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him in pain.”
passages.sermon:
Jabez was a man.
Jabez was more honorable than his brothers.
His mother gave him the name Jabez.
She said, “I gave birth to him in pain.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י יַעְבֵּ֔ץ נִכְבָּ֖ד מֵאֶחָ֑יו וְאִמּ֗וֹ קָרְאָ֨ה שְׁמ֤וֹ יַעְבֵּץ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כִּ֥י יָלַ֖דְתִּי בְּעֹֽצֶב׃

passages.text: And Jabez called out to the God of Israel, “If only You would bless me and enlarge my territory! May Your hand be with me and keep me from harm, so that I will be free from pain.” And God granted the request of Jabez.
passages.sermon:
Jabez was a man from the tribe of Judah.
Jabez called out to the God of Israel.
He prayed to God.
He said, "If only You would bless me."
He said, "Please enlarge my territory."
He said, "Let Your hand be with me."
He said, "Keep me from harm."
He said, "Let me be free from pain."
God granted Jabez what he asked.
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א יַ֠עְבֵּץ לֵאלֹהֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֵאמֹ֗ר אִם־ בָּרֵ֨ךְ תְּבָרֲכֵ֜נִי וְהִרְבִּ֤יתָ אֶת־ גְּבוּלִי֙ וְהָיְתָ֤ה יָדְךָ֙ עִמִּ֔י וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מֵּרָעָ֖ה לְבִלְתִּ֣י עָצְבִּ֑י וַיָּבֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁאָֽל׃

passages.text: Chelub the brother of Shuhah was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
passages.sermon: Chelub was the brother of Shuhah.\r\nChelub became the father of Mehir.\r\nMehir became the father of Eshton.
passages.original: וּכְל֥וּב אֲחִֽי־ שׁוּחָ֖ה הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ מְחִ֑יר ה֖וּא אֲבִ֥י אֶשְׁתּֽוֹן׃

passages.text: Eshton was the father of Beth-rapha, of Paseah, and of Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These were the men of Recah.
passages.sermon:
Eshton was a man in the genealogy of Judah.
Eshton became the father of Beth-rapha.
Eshton became the father of Paseah.
Eshton became the father of Tehinnah.
Tehinnah was the father of Ir-nahash.
Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah were descendants of Eshton.
These men were from Recah.
passages.original: וְאֶשְׁתּ֗וֹן הוֹלִ֞יד אֶת־ בֵּ֤ית רָפָא֙ וְאֶת־ פָּסֵ֔חַ וְאֶת־ תְּחִנָּ֖ה אֲבִ֣י עִ֣יר נָחָ֑שׁ אֵ֖לֶּה אַנְשֵׁ֥י רֵכָֽה׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath and Meonothai.
passages.sermon:
Kenaz had two sons.
Their names were Othniel and Seraiah.
Othniel had two sons.
Their names were Hathath and Meonothai.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י קְנַ֔ז עָתְנִיאֵ֖ל וּשְׂרָיָ֑ה וּבְנֵ֥י עָתְנִיאֵ֖ל חֲתַֽת׃

passages.text: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah, and Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of those living in Ge-harashim, which was given this name because its people were craftsmen.
passages.sermon:
Meonothai was the father of Ophrah.
Seraiah was the father of Joab.
Joab was the father of those who lived in Ge-harashim.
The people of Ge-harashim were craftsmen.
The place was called Ge-harashim because its people were craftsmen.
passages.original: וּמְעוֹנֹתַ֖י הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־ עָפְרָ֑ה וּשְׂרָיָ֗ה הוֹלִ֤יד אֶת־ יוֹאָב֙ אֲבִי֙ גֵּ֣יא חֲרָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י חֲרָשִׁ֖ים הָיֽוּ׃פ

passages.text: The sons of Caleb son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.
passages.sermon:
Caleb was the son of Jephunneh.
Caleb had three sons.
Their names were Iru, Elah, and Naam.
Elah had a son named Kenaz.
passages.original: וּבְנֵי֙ כָּלֵ֣ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּ֔ה עִ֥ירוּ אֵלָ֖ה וָנָ֑עַם וּבְנֵ֥י אֵלָ֖ה וּקְנַֽז׃

passages.text: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
passages.sermon: Jehallelel was a man in the tribe of Judah.\r\nJehallelel had sons.\r\nHis sons were Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י יְהַלֶּלְאֵ֑ל זִ֣יף וְזִיפָ֔ה תִּירְיָ֖א וַאֲשַׂרְאֵֽל׃

passages.text: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. And Mered’s wife Bithiah gave birth to Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
passages.sermon:
Ezrah had four sons.
Their names were Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon.
Mered had a wife named Bithiah.
Bithiah was the daughter of Pharaoh.
Bithiah gave birth to three children.
Their names were Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah.
Ishbah became the father of Eshtemoa.
passages.original: וּבֶן־ עֶזְרָ֔ה יֶ֥תֶר וּמֶ֖רֶד וְעֵ֣פֶר וְיָל֑וֹן וַתַּ֙הַר֙ אֶת־ מִרְיָ֣ם וְאֶת־ שַׁמַּ֔י וְאֶת־ יִשְׁבָּ֖ח אֲבִ֥י אֶשְׁתְּמֹֽעַ׃

passages.text: These were the children of Pharaoh’s daughter Bithiah. Mered also took a Judean wife, who gave birth to Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah.
passages.sermon:
Mered married a Judean woman.
She gave birth to Jered.
Jered became the father of Gedor.
She gave birth to Heber.
Heber became the father of Soco.
She gave birth to Jekuthiel.
Jekuthiel became the father of Zanoah.
These three sons were children of Mered’s Judean wife.
Bithiah was Pharaoh’s daughter.
Mered married Bithiah.
These are the children of Bithiah.
passages.original: וְאִשְׁתּ֣וֹ הַיְהֻדִיָּ֗ה יָלְדָ֞ה אֶת־ יֶ֨רֶד אֲבִ֤י גְדוֹר֙ וְאֶת־ חֶ֙בֶר֙ אֲבִ֣י שׂוֹכ֔וֹ וְאֶת־ יְקֽוּתִיאֵ֖ל אֲבִ֣י זָנ֑וֹחַ וְאֵ֗לֶּה בְּנֵי֙ בִּתְיָ֣ה בַת־ פַּרְעֹ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָקַ֖ח מָֽרֶד׃ס

passages.text: The sons of Hodiah’s wife, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and of Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
passages.sermon:
Hodiah had a wife.
This wife was the sister of Naham.
She had sons.
These sons became fathers.
One son became the father of Keilah the Garmite.
Another son became the father of Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
passages.original: וּבְנֵי֙ אֵ֣שֶׁת הֽוֹדִיָּ֔ה אֲח֣וֹת נַ֔חַם אֲבִ֥י קְעִילָ֖ה הַגַּרְמִ֑י וְאֶשְׁתְּמֹ֖עַ הַמַּעֲכָתִֽי׃

passages.text: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. The descendants of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.
passages.sermon:
Shimon was a man in the tribe of Israel.
Shimon had sons.
Their names were Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon.
Ishi was another man.
Ishi had descendants.
Their names were Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י שִׁימ֔וֹן אַמְנ֣וֹן וְרִנָּ֔ה בֶּן־ חָנָ֖ן וְתוֹלוֹן וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֔י זוֹחֵ֖ת וּבֶן־ זוֹחֵֽת׃

passages.text: The sons of Shelah son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah and the clans of the linen workers at Beth-ashbea, Jokim, the men of Cozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and Jashubi-lehem. (These names are from ancient records.)
passages.sermon:
Shelah was a son of Judah.
Shelah had sons.
Er was a son of Shelah.
Er was the father of Lecah.
Laadah was a son of Shelah.
Laadah was the father of Mareshah.
There were clans of linen workers at Beth-ashbea.
These clans came from Shelah.
Jokim was a descendant of Shelah.
The men of Cozeba were descendants of Shelah.
Joash was a descendant of Shelah.
Saraph was a descendant of Shelah.
Joash and Saraph ruled in Moab.
Jashubi-lehem was also a descendant of Shelah.
These names come from ancient records.
passages.original: בְּנֵי֙ שֵׁלָ֣ה בֶן־ יְהוּדָ֔ה עֵ֚ר אֲבִ֣י לֵכָ֔ה וְלַעְדָּ֖ה אֲבִ֣י מָרֵשָׁ֑ה וּמִשְׁפְּח֛וֹת בֵּית־ עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַבֻּ֖ץ לְבֵ֥ית אַשְׁבֵּֽעַ׃ וְיוֹקִ֞ים וְאַנְשֵׁ֣י כֹזֵבָ֗א וְיוֹאָ֧שׁ וְשָׂרָ֛ף אֲשֶׁר־ בָּעֲל֥וּ לְמוֹאָ֖ב וְיָשֻׁ֣בִי לָ֑חֶם וְהַדְּבָרִ֖ים עַתִּיקִֽים׃

passages.text: These were the potters who lived at Netaim and Gederah. They lived there in the service of the king.
passages.sermon:
These people were potters.
They lived at Netaim.
They also lived at Gederah.
They served the king.
They lived there while they worked for him.
passages.original: הֵ֚מָּה הַיּ֣וֹצְרִ֔ים וְיֹשְׁבֵ֥י נְטָעִ֖ים וּגְדֵרָ֑ה עִם־ הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ בִּמְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ יָ֥שְׁבוּ שָֽׁם׃ס

passages.text: The descendants of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
passages.sermon: Simeon was a son of Jacob.\r\nSimeon had descendants.\r\nThe descendants of Simeon were Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֖י שִׁמְע֑וֹן נְמוּאֵ֣ל וְיָמִ֔ין יָרִ֖יב זֶ֥רַח שָׁאֽוּל׃

passages.text: The sons of Shaul: Shallum, Mibsam, and Mishma.
passages.sermon: Shaul was a descendant of Simeon.\r\nShaul had three sons.\r\nTheir names were Shallum, Mibsam, and Mishma.
passages.original: שַׁלֻּ֥ם בְּנ֛וֹ מִבְשָׂ֥ם בְּנ֖וֹ מִשְׁמָ֥ע בְּנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel, Zaccur, and Shimei.
passages.sermon:
Mishma was a descendant of Simeon.
Mishma had three sons.
The first son was Hammuel.
The second son was Zaccur.
The third son was Shimei.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֖י מִשְׁמָ֑ע חַמּוּאֵ֥ל בְּנ֛וֹ זַכּ֥וּר בְּנ֖וֹ שִׁמְעִ֥י בְנֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children, so their whole clan did not become as numerous as the sons of Judah.
passages.sermon:
Shimei was a man from the tribe of Simeon.
Shimei had sixteen sons.
Shimei had six daughters.
Shimei’s brothers did not have many children.
The whole family of Shimei and his brothers did not grow large.
Their clan was not as numerous as the sons of Judah.
passages.original: וּלְשִׁמְעִ֞י בָּנִ֨ים שִׁשָּׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ וּבָנ֣וֹת שֵׁ֔שׁ וּלְאֶחָ֕יו אֵ֖ין בָּנִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְכֹל֙ מִשְׁפַּחְתָּ֔ם לֹ֥א הִרְבּ֖וּ עַד־ בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃ס

passages.text: They lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual, Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad, Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag, Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, and Shaaraim. These were their cities until the reign of David.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Mishma were a clan in Israel.
They lived in several cities.
They lived in Beersheba.
They lived in Moladah.
They lived in Hazar-shual.
They lived in Bilhah.
They lived in Ezem.
They lived in Tolad.
They lived in Bethuel.
They lived in Hormah.
They lived in Ziklag.
They lived in Beth-marcaboth.
They lived in Hazar-susim.
They lived in Beth-biri.
They lived in Shaaraim.
These cities belonged to them.
They lived in these cities until David became king.
passages.original: וַיֵּֽשְׁב֛וּ בִּבְאֵֽר־ שֶׁ֥בַע וּמוֹלָדָ֖ה וַחֲצַ֥ר שׁוּעָֽל׃ וּבְבִלְהָ֥ה וּבְעֶ֖צֶם וּבְתוֹלָֽד׃ וּבִבְתוּאֵ֥ל וּבְחָרְמָ֖ה וּבְצִֽיקְלָֽג׃ וּבְבֵ֤ית מַרְכָּבוֹת֙ וּבַחֲצַ֣ר סוּסִ֔ים וּבְבֵ֥ית בִּרְאִ֖י וּֽבְשַׁעֲרָ֑יִם אֵ֥לֶּה עָרֵיהֶ֖ם עַד־ מְלֹ֥ךְ דָּוִֽיד׃

passages.text: And their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan—five towns— and all their surrounding villages as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept a genealogical record: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu son of Joshibiah (son of Seraiah, son of Asiel), Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, and Ziza son of Shiphi (son of Allon, son of Jedaiah, son of Shimri, son of Shemaiah).
passages.sermon:
These people had villages.
Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan.
These were five towns.
They also had villages around these towns.
Their villages reached as far as Baal.
These places were their settlements.
They kept a record of their families.
The leaders were Meshobab, Jamlech, and Joshah son of Amaziah.
Joel was also a leader.
Jehu was a leader.
Jehu was the son of Joshibiah.
Joshibiah was the son of Seraiah.
Seraiah was the son of Asiel.
Elioenai was a leader.
Jaakobah was a leader.
Jeshohaiah was a leader.
Asaiah was a leader.
Adiel was a leader.
Jesimiel was a leader.
Benaiah was a leader.
Ziza was a leader.
Ziza was the son of Shiphi.
Shiphi was the son of Allon.
Allon was the son of Jedaiah.
Jedaiah was the son of Shimri.
Shimri was the son of Shemaiah.
passages.original: וְחַצְרֵיהֶם֙ עֵיטָ֣ם וָעַ֔יִן רִמּ֥וֹן וְתֹ֖כֶן וְעָשָׁ֑ן עָרִ֖ים חָמֵֽשׁ׃ וְכָל־ חַצְרֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר סְבִיב֛וֹת הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה עַד־ בָּ֑עַל זֹ֚את מוֹשְׁבֹתָ֔ם וְהִתְיַחְשָׂ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃ וּמְשׁוֹבָ֣ב וְיַמְלֵ֔ךְ וְיוֹשָׁ֖ה בֶּן־ אֲמַצְיָֽה׃ וְיוֹאֵ֑ל וְיֵהוּא֙ בֶּן־ י֣וֹשִׁבְיָ֔ה בֶּן־ שְׂרָיָ֖ה בֶּן־ עֲשִׂיאֵֽל׃ וְאֶלְיוֹעֵינַ֡י וְֽיַעֲקֹ֡בָה וִ֠ישׁוֹחָיָה וַעֲשָׂיָ֧ה וַעֲדִיאֵ֛ל וִישִׂימִאֵ֖ל וּבְנָיָֽה׃ וְזִיזָ֨א בֶן־ שִׁפְעִ֧י בֶן־ אַלּ֛וֹן בֶּן־ יְדָיָ֥ה בֶן־ שִׁמְרִ֖י בֶּן־ שְׁמַֽעְיָֽה׃

passages.text: These men listed by name were the leaders of their clans. Their families increased greatly, and they journeyed to the entrance of Gedor, to the east side of the valley, in search of pasture for their flocks.
passages.sermon:
These men were leaders of their clans.
The Bible lists their names.
Their families grew very large.
They traveled to the entrance of Gedor.
Gedor was on the east side of the valley.
They went there to find pasture for their flocks.
passages.original: אֵ֚לֶּה הַבָּאִ֣ים בְּשֵׁמ֔וֹת נְשִׂיאִ֖ים בְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֑ם וּבֵית֙ אֲב֣וֹתֵיהֶ֔ם פָּרְצ֖וּ לָרֽוֹב׃ וַיֵּלְכוּ֙ לִמְב֣וֹא גְדֹ֔ר עַ֖ד לְמִזְרַ֣ח הַגָּ֑יְא לְבַקֵּ֥שׁ מִרְעֶ֖ה לְצֹאנָֽם׃

passages.text: There they found rich, good pasture, and the land was spacious, peaceful, and quiet; for some Hamites had lived there formerly.
passages.sermon:
The men from the tribe of Simeon searched for land for their flocks.
They found pasture that was rich and good.
The land was wide and open.
The land was peaceful.
The land was quiet.
Hamites had lived there before.
passages.original: וַֽיִּמְצְא֤וּ מִרְעֶה֙ שָׁמֵ֣ן וָט֔וֹב וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ רַחֲבַ֣ת יָדַ֔יִם וְשֹׁקֶ֖טֶת וּשְׁלֵוָ֑ה כִּ֣י מִן־ חָ֔ם הַיֹּשְׁבִ֥ים שָׁ֖ם לְפָנִֽים׃

passages.text: These who were noted by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah. They attacked the Hamites and Meunites there in their dwellings, devoting them to destruction even to this day. Then they settled in their place, because there was pasture for their flocks.
passages.sermon:
These men were leaders of their clans.
People recorded their names.
They came during the days of Hezekiah, king of Judah.
They found the Hamites and Meunites living there.
They attacked the Hamites and Meunites in their tents.
They destroyed them completely.
This destruction remains until today.
The leaders and their people settled in the land.
They lived there because the land had pasture for their flocks.
passages.original: וַיָּבֹ֡אוּ אֵלֶּה֩ הַכְּתוּבִ֨ים בְּשֵׁמ֜וֹת בִּימֵ֣י׀ יְחִזְקִיָּ֣הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יְהוּדָ֗ה וַיַּכּ֨וּ אֶת־ אָהֳלֵיהֶ֜ם וְאֶת־ הַמְּעִינִים אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִמְצְאוּ־ שָׁ֙מָּה֙ וַיַּחֲרִימֻם֙ עַד־ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ תַּחְתֵּיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־ מִרְעֶ֥ה לְצֹאנָ֖ם שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: And five hundred of these Simeonites led by Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, went to Mount Seir and struck down the remnant of the Amalekites who had escaped. And they have lived there to this day.
passages.sermon:
Five hundred men from the tribe of Simeon went to Mount Seir.
Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel led them.
These four men were sons of Ishi.
The Simeonites attacked the remaining Amalekites who had escaped.
They defeated the Amalekites.
The Simeonites settled in Mount Seir.
They have lived there until today.
passages.original: וּמֵהֶ֣ם׀ מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֗וֹן הָלְכוּ֙ לְהַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר אֲנָשִׁ֖ים חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וּפְלַטְיָ֡ה וּ֠נְעַרְיָה וּרְפָיָ֧ה וְעֻזִּיאֵ֛ל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׁעִ֖י בְּרֹאשָֽׁם׃ וַיַּכּ֕וּ אֶת־ שְׁאֵרִ֥ית הַפְּלֵטָ֖ה לַעֲמָלֵ֑ק וַיֵּ֣שְׁבוּ שָׁ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
